name: Ash Wastes
description: Irradiated plains of grey ash over the old continents, where collapsed towers stand like grave markers.
role: The dangerous heart of the aftermath. Rich in relics, poor in life, hostile to the unprepared.
ambience: Dry wind, drifting ash, a sick yellow haze and the silence of dead cities.
paletteDirection: Ash greys and bone white, sick yellow haze, black soot in the cracks.
